name: RLBench
summary: RLBench offers 100 hand-designed manipulation tasks with unlimited demonstration generation via motion planning, plus multi-view RGB-D observations. Its keyframe-friendly structure made it the standard proving ground for PerAct, RVT and 3D Diffuser Actor, though its scripted demonstrations differ in character from human teleoperation.
innovation: Unlimited procedurally generated demonstrations, removing data collection as a confound when comparing methods.
A multi-view RGB-D setup that enabled the entire 3D policy research line.
matters: The shared yardstick for spatial and 3D manipulation architectures.
limits: Motion-planner demonstrations lack the multimodality of human data; simulation only.
lineage: An early standardized simulation benchmark underpinning the 3D policy branch.
